record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: Let A be an Artin local ring over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic 0, finite-dimensional over k. Is the length of the Kähler differentials Ω^1_A always at least l(A)-1, with equality if and only if A is isomorphic to k[x]/(x^n)?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 1. Is it true that l(Ω1 A) ≥ l(A) − 1 and equality if and only if A is isomorphic to k[x]/x n ?

artifact.category_tag: Kähler differentials of Artin local rings
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, and let $A$ be an Artin local $k$-algebra that is finite-dimensional as a $k$-vector space. Write $\ell(M)$ for the length of a finitely generated $A$-module $M$, and let $\Omega^{1}_{A/k}$ denote the module of Kähler differentials of $A$ over $k$. Determine whether the following two statements hold:

(a) $\ell(\Omega^{1}_{A/k}) \ge \ell(A) - 1$.

(b) Equality $\ell(\Omega^{1}_{A/k}) = \ell(A) - 1$ holds if and only if $A$ is isomorphic, as a $k$-algebra, to $k[x]/(x^{n})$ for some integer $n \ge 1$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is the Artinian form of Berger's conjecture (the "Artin–Berger conjecture") studied by Cortiñas, Geller, and Weibel; they established it in a number of cases, but the general statement (and the original Berger conjecture for one-dimensional local rings, which it would imply in characteristic 0) remains open. Recent work (e.g., Huneke–Iyengar et al., 2022) continues to extend known cases but does not resolve the full conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The Artinian Berger Conjecture (Cortiñas–Geller–Weibel)
status_evidence.snippet: We propose an Artinian version of a conjecture of R. Berger... establish this Artinian Berger Conjecture in a number of cases... implies Berger's Conjecture in characteristic 0.
status_evidence.claim: The Artinian version was formulated and proved in certain cases, but not in general.

status_evidence.title: Torsion in Differentials and Berger's Conjecture (2022)
status_evidence.snippet: New cases of Berger's conjecture proven by extending works of Güttes and Cortiñas et al.
status_evidence.claim: Berger's conjecture remains an active open problem with new partial cases.

status_evidence.title: On one-dimensional local rings and Berger's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Berger's conjecture and proves new cases.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is still being investigated; not fully resolved.
